newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australia bond rally wanes,CPI hopes prove correct.
newsitem.headline: Australia bond rally wanes,CPI hopes prove correct.

text.p: *The strong rally in Australian bonds was showing signs of waning after Wednesday's benign inflation reading was within the expected range and with a 1/2 point rate cut factored in.
*Greenspan to give rest of testimony, wages data Thursday.

Australia once again produced a stunningly low inflation performance in the June quarter, but for the bond market it came as little surprise and left it struggling to advance its strong rally since April.

"The CPI result was even a little better than expected, but the interest-rate market had left very little room for a further rally since the next rate cut is almost priced in," said Chris Caton, chief economist at Bankers Trust Australia.
The policy sensitive annual underlying inflation rate fell to 1.7 percent, its lowest since the series started in 1971.
